# Cornerstone AI

Cornerstone is an AI advisory and development agency, founded and run by Cristo Van Rensburg in South Africa, working with businesses anywhere. It builds the foundations a business scales on in the agentic era: the process, the data and the way work moves, then the systems that enforce them.

Three things, in this order:

- Advise: find what is capping the business and design the process it should run on, before anything gets built.
- Build: custom systems inside the client's own accounts, owned outright, with no licence and no platform fee. The rule is the smallest system that enforces the new process.
- Adopt: the team uses it from the day it lands and is still using it a year later.

Systems built by Cornerstone run BioHarmony (e-commerce), Technolease (rent-to-own), Roxburgh Trust (fiduciary), ETJ Consulting (accounting) and A Better Question (podcast). Cornerstone runs on the same kind of system itself.

Free resources for founders scaling with AI and systems (skills, guides, templates from real client work): https://cornerstone-ai.pro/resources

Contact: info@cornerstone-ai.pro or https://cornerstone-ai.pro/#contact. Weekly newsletter, Simple Systems Saturday: https://cornerstone-ai.pro/simple-systems

Cornerstone AI (Pty) Ltd, South Africa.
